Because you deserve more than words…

You don't deserve just a paragraph. You deserve a thousand books written about how amazing you are.

You're beautiful, and when you smile, it's the prettiest thing I've ever seen. I love everything about you — starting from your beautiful eyes, which are more beautiful than any sunrise or sunset. And I love your smile; it makes me want to make you smile every chance I get.

And if I could give you one thing today, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes — just once — so you could finally understand how precious, beautiful, and deeply loved you truly are.

May Allah fill your life with endless happiness, protect your beautiful heart, grant you everything you quietly pray for, and keep that beautiful smile on your face forever. 🤍
